other_conditions: Applicant must belong to listed sub‑castes among schedule castes (e.g., Arundathiyar, Chammadiya, Chamar, etc.).
Annual family income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas.
Applicant or family members must not have received benefits from other schemes, except training programs.
Family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations.
benefits_summary: Provides leather stitching machines, toolkits, and a ₹6,000 stipend after training.
